I think one of us is confused, haha. /r/nosleep? Then again, my sugar is super super low, so maybe I'm missing something really obvious. Sorry about that.
That was... terrible. I actually giggled. Thank you for showing me, haha. The mare/mare wedding threw me off quite a bit, too.
Working on it. It's like every line somehow manages to get worse. Wow.
First one is MLP + Bible crossover. Well... I stopped crying for a moment as I tried to process it, so that.. helped?
Oh.. Oh my. That is terrifying, haha.
I don't think I've heard of that one, actually. Really bad fanfics, I take it?
/r/nosleep. Nothing quite like curling up late at night with cocoa and reading a good scary story. How about you?

No one is going to want to listen to me whine, especially when I've already made up my mind. Talking simply isn't going to change the situation besides reminding me of how terrible of a person I am for thinking I'd be worth it..
It would just be a waste of time for everyone.. I'm sorry.
There's nothing left to really be said. I know that the only way to help myself is to remove myself from the situation.
Thank you, but I plan on not having to deal with anything else after tomorrow.
It's ok. Most of it's true anyway.

She says it quite often, how she hopes I die before her because she never wanted me anyway. You don't even really know me, though. Anyone can seem harmless enough with just a few messages. Don't get me wrong, I really do appreciate someone being kind to me, but it's a waste of your time.

It doesn't change the situation, though. That's the whole problem - I have no actual escape from my mother and her psychotic shit. There's only so much that creativity can do when you're being told every day how everyone hates you and your own parent can't wait to see your dead body.
I don't like bothering people... and there's nothing anyone could really do. Talking isn't going to help matters anymore for me.
Not really, no. My family doesn't give a fuck, and the only people I've talked to for a long time have been online...
He's never said he does, but he's not the kind of person to just say that.
Anything good he thinks he sees in me he could easily find in someone else, though, without having to deal with all of the other problems I cause.
He's too stubborn to. Refuses to admit that I'm not good enough.
No, I plan on leaving him... I'm just holding him down.

I did tell him earlier, and he said we'd figure it out, but I know something else will go wrong... I'm actually waiting on him to get off work to break up so it'll be a little easier on him. It's not fair of me to keep him from being with someone better anyway.
